newsitem.title: UK: POLL-Labour slips 3 points in Scots opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Labour slips 3 points in Scots opinion poll.

text.p: Britain's ruling Labour party slipped three points in a month from an all-time high of 57 percent and Conservatives gained three from an all-time low of nine percent in the latest Scottish opinion poll.
The Scottish National Party (SNP) was unchanged in second place with 23 percent and Liberal Democrats unchanged on 10 in the System Three poll published in the Herald newspaper on Wednesday.

The poll was carried out by face-to-face interviews across Scotland between June 26 and July 1, the time of new Conservative leader William Hague's visit to the annual Scottish Conservative Party conference.
Conservatives lost all 10 of their Scottish parliamentary seats in the May 1 general election and, with only 82 of some 1,300 local councillors, do not control any of the country's local authorities.
